༄༅/ /rnam 'grel snga ldang gi sbyor ba yod/ /rnam 'grel nyi ma dang po'i snga ldang ba/'dis grub yan lag man gyi gzhan don hril yong bas/ /'dis grub

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam 'grel snga ldang gi sbyor ba yod// rnam 'grel nyi ma dang po'i snga ldang ba/ 'dis grub yan lag man gyi gzhan don hril yong bas/ /'dis grub yan lag gyur pa zhes sogs la/ chos kyi ngo bo la gnod pa phyogs skyon du bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ chos kyi khyad par la gnod pa sogs phyogs skyon du bstan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ de la don ni bstan pa yi zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis la/ chos kyi ngo bo la gnod pa'i dpe brjod bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ chos kyi khyad par la gnod pa sogs mtshon pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ ldan don rdzas kyi mtshan nyid can zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis la/ shes bya chos can/ skabs 'dir bye brag pa'i dam bca' yod de/ yan lag can yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' de de yin pa'i phyir/ khas blangs rang gi tshig sogs kyi zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi la/ chos kyi khyad par 'gog pa'i dam bca' chos can/ khyod la tshad ma gzhan gyis kyang gnod pa yin te/ bye brag pa rang gi khas blangs sogs kyis gnod pa'i phyir/ bya ba dus gsum yul can phyir/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi la/ dpe rtags ma grub pa chos can/ bsgrub bya ma yin te/ de'i mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i phyir/ tshogs pa bsgrub bya nyid yin na'ang / /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi la/ shes bya chos can/ sgras khyad par du byas pa'i mi rtag pa bsgrub bya yang dag yin te/ sgra dang mi rtag pa'i tshogs don bsgrub bya yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs rab tu dbye ba'i don sogs la/ mdor phyogs chos can gyi gtan tshigs dgur mdor bsdus nas gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ phyogs chos can gyi gtan tshigs rnams phyogs gnyis la 'jug tshul bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ /chos kyi tshig phrad tha dad par sogs rkang pa bzhi la/ nges bzung dngos su sbyar ba'i rnam dpyod chos can/

gsum yod de/ khyad par dang nges bzung dngos su sbyar ba sogs gsum yod pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin 'bras bu grub don du/ /sogs rkang pa bzhi la/ 'bras rang gi rtags gnyis dang / 'gal rtags gnyis kyi dpe brjod smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ skabs kyi rjes khyab sgrub pa la mthun phyogs la 'jug pa cig dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin nyid las gzhan gyis ni/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi la/ byas pa rang bzhin rtags kyi dper smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ 'bras rtags rnams mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis su 'jug par bstan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu dang ngo bo ldog nyid kyis/ /sogs rkang pa bzhi la/ shes bya chos can/ rgyu khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyi dper brjod mi smos pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'bras rang gi ldog 'gro grub pas de gnyis kyi rjes 'gro grub par rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ gcig dmigs nyams su myong ba las/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi la/ bum pas dag pa'i sa phyogs 'dzin pa'i dbang mngon nyams myong gi rang rig chos can/ khyod kyi 'bras bu skyed tshul yod de/ rang 'bras dran shes gnyis skyed pa'i phyir ro/ /nyi ma gnyis pa'i snga ldang la tshad 'bras gnyis pa man yong bas/ rdul phran de dag gang gis na sogs rkang pa gnyis la/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon chos can/ khyod phyi don dang 'dra ba min te/ phyi don rdul phran dang rags pa gang dang yang 'dra ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gzhan rig med pa'i phyir/ /sogs rkang pa gnyis la/ sngo 'dzin dbang mngon chos can/ khyod kyi rang gi bdag nyid du gyur pa'i gzugs rig pa yin te/ khyod la rang dus su snang ba'i gzugs de khyad kyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mthong ba'i khyad par dang bral ba sogs la/ sngo 'dzin dbang mngon la gzugs su snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ phyi don ma yin te/ sngo 'dzin dbang sngon dang lhan cig dmigs nges yin pa'i phyir ro/

/phyi rol don ni yod na yang / /zhes sogs la/ don snang gi dbang shes la don du snang ba chos can/ phyi don rang ngos nas gtad pa ma yin te/ nang bag chags kho nas gtad pa yin pa'i phyir/ de phyir phyi rol gzhal bya la'ang / zhes sogs la/ shes bya chos can/ gzugs gzhal byar byed pa'i tshe na don rtogs 'bras bur rigs te/ don snang gi dbang mngon des gzugs rtogs pa'i phyir/ de tshe don snang 'di nyid ni/ /tshad yin zhes pa la/ /shes bya chos can/ gzugs gzhal byar gzhag pa'i tshe/ don 'dra ba tshad ma yin te/ don 'dra bas gzugs rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /de dang 'dra ba'am gzhan 'dra'ang rung / zhes sogs la/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon chos can/ gzugs de khyod kyi gzhal bya yin te/ gzugs de khyod la rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ blo bdag rnam par dbyer med kyang sogs la/ don snang gi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum chos can/ ldog pa tha dad yin te/ rtog ngor tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ dper na 'dod chags sogs myong bzhin sogs la/ dbang mngon chos can/ khyod gzhal bya/ 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ rang rig 'bras bur byed pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam bzhag yod de/ khyod shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon chos can/ khyod gzugs kyi rnam ldan du skyes te/ gzugs de khyod la rnam pa gtod byed yin pa'i phyir/ nges par blo dang lhan gcig tu/ /zhes sogs la/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon la gzugs su snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon dang rdzas gzhan ma yin te/ de dang lhan cig dmigs nges yin pa'i phyir/ /gal te mtshungs pa de ma thag /zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis la/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon chos can/ rang gi dmigs rkyen phyi don las skyes pa ma yin te/ rang gi mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen gyi bag chags kyi dbang gis skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/ de la'ang du bar snang ba'i blos/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi la/

dur snang gi bag chags sad pa'i blo chos can/ du ldan lar snang gi bag chags sad pa'i shes rgyud la mer snang gi bag chags sad pa'i blo 'byung rung du sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag yin te/ de ltar sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /tshul gnyis sgrub par byed pas kyang / sogs rkang pa gnyis la/ tshul gnyis sgrub byed kyi rigs pa chos can/ khyod la brten nas rang rig kyang grub pa yin te/ de shugs la grub pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /nyi ma rting ma snga ldang ba la gnyis kyi sgra ma grub kyang man yong bas/ sgra ma grub kyang dngos po ni/ /zhes sogs la/ lus can chos can/ /khyod 'byung bzhi'i rdul phran mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag yin te/ de ltar sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ sgrub byed thugs rje goms las te/ /zhes pa la/ tshad ma'i skyes bu chos can/ khyod sgrub byed kyi thabs yod de/ brtse ba snying rje chen po skye ba du mar goms pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ brtse ldan sdug bsngal gzhom pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs la brtse ldan byang sems chos can/ khyod kyi bden bzhi rtogs pa la dgos pa yod de/ gzhan sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ rnam pa du mar thabs goms pa/ /zhes sogs la/ ston shāka chos can/ khyod skyon kun zad kyi gang zag yin te/ thabs la goms pa mthar thug pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu spangs yon tan gsum bde gshegs zhes sogs la/ ston shāka gi rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ bde gshegs yin te/ spangs pa khyad par gsum ldan yin pa'i phyir/ bdag lta'i sa bon spangs pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs la/ ston shāka gi rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ slar mi ldog pa'i spangs pa yin te/ bdag lta'i sa bon spangs pa mthar thug pa'i spangs pa yin pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po/ /zhes sogs la/ thog med nas 'khor ba'i nyer len gyi phung po chos can/

sdug bsngal bden pa yin te/ sdug bsngal rnam gsum gang rung gis bsdus pa'i zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ res 'ga' ba nyid yin pas na/ /zhes sogs la res 'ga' skye ba chos can/ sdug bsngal bden pa rgyu dang bcas par sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags yang dag yin te/ de ltar sgrub pa'i 'bras bus tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ de ni gtan du ba min te/ /zhes sogs la/ sred pa chos can/ khyod gtan du ba ma yin te/ khyod kyi rgyu la gnyen pos gegs byed pa'i phyir/ gang dag brtse ba chen po ba/ /zhes sogs la/ theg chen 'phags pa chos can/ gzhan don la bzhugs pa yin te/ de'i rgyu brtse ba chen po mnga' ba'i phyir/ 'di yul sun phyung med par ni/ /zhes sogs la/ bdag med rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ khyed kyis bdag 'dzin spong ba'i tshul yod de/ yul bdag sun phyung ba'i sgo nas spong ba'i phyir/ bshad zin lam de goms pa las/ /zhes sogs la/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab chos can/ khyod thar pa thob pa'i thabs yin te/ khyod goms pa las gnas gyur mthar thug thob pa'i phyir/ skyob las de nyid dang gtan zhes sogs la/ thub dbang chos can/ thams cad mkhyen pa yin te/ skyob pa yin pa'i phyir/ de lta'i dngos don bstod pa ni/ /zhes sogs la/ bcom ldan 'das la tshad ma'i sgo nas bstod pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ thub pa'i bstan pa la tshad ma'i rnam gzhag grub pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ med na mi 'byung mtshan nyid can/ /zhes sogs la/ ston pa'i bstan pa 'dir rjes dpag chos can/ khyod bshad de/ khyod kyi rten rtags bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gong du skyob pa nyid gzigs lam gsung ba/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi la/ ston shāka chos can/ skyob pa yin te/ rang gi gzigs pa'i lam gzhan la ston pa'i ston pa yin pa'i phyir/ yang na skyob/ bden pa bzhi ni ston mdzad pa'o zhes pa la ston shāka chos can/ skyob pa yin te/

bden bzhi ston pa'i ston pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam 'grel nyi ma gsum ka'i snga ldang rdzogs so// //rnam 'grel bar ldang gi sbyor ba yod/ /nyi ma dang po'i bar ldang ba la/ gzhan don gyi/ rang nyid tshig phrad nas/ yan lag rdzas 'gog gi bar yong bas/ rang nyid tshig phrad ngo bo'i sgra/ /zhes sogs la/ phyogs yang dag gi mtshan nyid kyi zur lnga smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ gzhan don phyogs yang dag la ma khyab khyab ches mi srid pa'i skyon gsum spang pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ khas blangs de yang tshad ma ni/ /zhes sogs la/ gzhan don phyogs yang dag gi mtshan nyid kyi zur du ma bsal ba zhes smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ tshad mas bsal ba zhugs pa rnams bsgrub bya yang dag yin pa bcad par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ de la khas blangs 'bras rtags te/ /zhes sogs la/ dpyad gsum dag pa'i lung chos can/ khyod bka' brgyad stong pa rang gi bstan don rtogs pa'i tshad ma snga ma sngon song du sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags yang dag yin te/ de sgrub kyi 'bras bu'i tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ yang dag nges ldan brjod 'dod pa/ /zhes sogs la/ yid ches rang lung gnyis chos can/ khyod phyogs gcig tu 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bdag gzhan yid ches kyi gnas su mtshungs pa'i phyir/ tha snyad las ni skyes pa yi/ /zhes sogs la/ zla sgras brjod rung chos can/ khyod la grags pa'i ming 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod grags pa'i yul yin pas de ltar btags pa'i phyir/ skyes bu'i 'dod dang rjes 'brel ba/ /zhes sogs la/ zla ba zhes pa'i sgra chos can/ khyod don rang gi zhen don gyi gtso bo la grags pas gnod pa 'bab pa chos can/ grags pa dang 'gal ba'i dam bca' ltar snang gi mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ nyi ma gnyis pa'i bar ldang la mtshan nyid brtags pa yong bas/ shes bya kun la chos gsum gyis/

/zhes sogs la/ bum sogs shes bya kun chos can/ khyod la mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum gyis khyab ste/ sgra blo ma 'khrul bas zhen du rung ba'i phyir/ rnam 'jog rgyu ni ma nges par/ /zhes sogs la/ lto ldir ba chos can/ khyod ma nges par bum pa nges pa med de/ khyod bum pa'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang mtshan nyid gnyis ka la/ zhes sogs la/ rtags dang mtshan nyid kyi sbyor ba chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis yod de/ spyi dang bye brag gi sbyor ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ tshul gsum du ba kho na'i chos/ /zhes sogs la/ du ba chos can/ khyod tshul gsum yin te/ rtags yin pa'i phyir/ dngos 'gal gcod pa'i don ldog yin/ zhes pa la/ dngos 'gal gcod pa'i don ldog grub pa chos can/ mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab khyab ches mi srid gsum/ zhes sogs la/ mtshan nyid kyi skyon chos can/ gsum yod de/ ma khyab khyab ches mi srid pa'i skyon gsum yod pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan can gyi sgra shes ni/ /zhes sogs la thub dbang chos can/ tshad ma dang ldan te/ bden bzhi'i blang dor la mi bslu ma shes don gsal gnyis dang ldan pa'i phyir/ ma skyes pa ni ldog don du/ /zhes sogs la/ gyur pa smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ rang byung gi tshad ma'i skyes bu dgag pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ bsgrub bya'i rjes 'gro phyir 'bras bu/ /zhes sogs la/ byas pa chos can/ khyod sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag ma yin par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs te/ 'bras mtshungs kyi ltag chod yin te/ khyod sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir ro// //maṅga laṃ//rigs gter nyi ma dang po'i bar ldang ba la/ /bsgrub bya nas gzhan don gyi bar yong bas/ mdo las mtshan nyid lnga ldan gsungs/ /zhes pa la ngo bo'i don sogs chos lnga tshang ba chos can/ gzhan don bsgrub bya yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin te/

de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ bsgrub byar 'dod pa rigs pa'i sgor/ /zhes pa la/ skabs kyi rgol bas bsgrub bya yang dag tu khas blangs pa chos can/ rtags gsal 'dra/ dam bca' nyid na myong ba dang / zhes sogs la/ dam bca' ltar snang gang zhig rang gi zhen don gyi gtso bo la mngon sum gyis gnod pa 'bab pa chos can/ mngon sum dang 'gal ba'i dam bca' ltar snang gi mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ tshul gsum dngos po stobs zhugs dang / /zhes sogs la/ dam bca' ltar snang gang zhig rang gi zhen don la dngos stobs kyis gnod pa 'bab pa chos can/ dngos stobs dang 'gal ba'i dam bca' ltar snang gi mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ yid ches tshig dang dam bca' ba/ /zhes sogs la/ dam bca' ltar snang gang zhig rang gi zhen don la yid ches kyis gnod pa 'bab pa chos can/ yid ches dang 'gal ba'i dam bca' ltar snang gi mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ des na rigs pas grub pa'i lung / /zhes sogs la/ rang gi brjod don gyi gtso bo tshad mas grub pa'i lung chos can/ lung rnam dag gi mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ gzhal bya gnyis la tshad ma gnyis/ /zhes sogs la/ dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i lung chos can/ lung rnam dag gi mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ de nyid phyir na 'jig rten dang / /zhes sogs la/ dam bca' ltar snang gang zhig thams cad la 'jug rung yin te/ don thams cad khyod kyi brjod byar rung ba'i phyir/ ri bong can zlar mi 'dod pa/ /zhes sogs la/ rtog yul na yod pa chos can/ /khyod ri bong can zla sgras brjod mi rung du sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag ma yin te/ khyod de ltar sgrub pa'i tshul gsum ma tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ grub pa tha dad bshad pa la/ zhes sogs la/ yid ches dang grags pa'i gnod tshul rgyas par bshad pa chos can/

dgos pa yod de/ de gnyis dngos stobs las gnod yul tha dad du bstan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ kun tu rgol ba bdag nyid kyis/ /zhes sogs la/ rang rten la smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ skabs kyi sgrub chos kyi rten la gnod na skabs kyi bsgrub bya la gnod par bstan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ nyi ma rting ma'i bar ldang la/ rang don gyi rang bzhin khyad par bye brag nas/ le gnyis kyi sgra ma grub kyang gi bar yong bas/ le gnyis nas/ tshad ma bslu med pa la yang / /rang las rang gi ngo bo rtogs/ /zhes sogs la/ dbang mngon chos can/ khyod shes pa yin par rtogs byed yod de/ rang myong rang rig mngon sum las rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ de ldan bcom ldan tshad ma nyid/ /ces pa la rgyu mtshan can gyi sgra shes grub pa chos can/ mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid gnyis kyis 'jog na ni/ /zhes sogs la/ tshad ma chos can/ khyod la mtshan nyid don tha dad pa gnyis med de/ khyod mtshon bya don tha dad pa gnyis min pa'i phyir/ mi bslu ma shes don gsal gnyis/ /zhes sogs la/ ma shes don gsal gyi rig pa chos can/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ mi bslu las dang byed po dang / /zhes sogs la/ khyad chos gsum ldan gyi mi bslu ba chos can/ yul can gyi mi bslu ba'i mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ nges dang sgro 'dogs zhen yul gcig /ces sogs la/ sgra mi rtag par nges pa'i nges shes kyis sgra rtag 'dzin gyi sgro 'dogs sel ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de gnyis zhen gzhi gcig la zhen stangs tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ des na yang dag shes pa nyid/ /ces sogs la shes bya chos can/ mngon rjes gnyis kyi dbye gzhi yod de/ yang dag pa'i shes pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na mngon sum rjes dpag gnyis/ /zhes pa la tshad ma chos can/

khyod kyi dbye ngo yod de mngon rjes gnyis po de de yin pa'i phyir/ don rig gnyis dang rang rig dang / /zhes sogs la/ don rig gnyis po chos can/ rang nges tshad ma yin te/ rang las nges kyi tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po pa dang yid ma gtad ces sogs la/ dang po pa'i mngon sum sogs chos can/ gzhan nges tshad ma yin te/ gzhan las nges kyi tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ /snang ba dngos po'i yul can yin/ /zhes sogs la/ sel ba chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis yod de/ sel ba'i dgag sgrub gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dgag pa sgrub pa spong ba dang / /zhes sogs la/ dgag pa chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis yod de/ med dgag dang / ma yin dgag gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rigs gter nyi ma gnyis pa'i bar ldang rdzogs so// //rigs gter nyi ma gsum pa'i sbyor ba yod/ /rig gter nyi ma gsum pa'i phyi ldang ba la/ rab byed dang po gnyis yong bas/ yul gyi mtshan nyid blos rig bya/ /zhes pa la/ blos rig par bya ba chos can/ yul gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ gzhal bya rang mtshan gcig kho na/ /zhes pa la shes bya chos can/ gzung yul gyi gzhal bya yin na rang mtshan yin pas khyab ste/ don spyi sogs gzung yul ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'jug tshul sgo nas rang spyi gnyis/ /zhes pa la shes bya chos can/ gzhal bya la rang spyi gnyis su grangs nges te/ 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas de ltar grangs nges pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid dang / zhes sogs la/ grub mtha' smra ba chos can/ gnyis yod de/ phyi nang gi sgo nas gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rang la shar na zhes sogs la/ tshad ma la yul gyi rnam pa shar ba chos can/ tshad mas yul rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ gcig dang du ma zhes sogs la/ phyi don chos can/ bden par med de/ bden pa'i gcig dang du ma gang rung dang bral ba'i phyir/ gsal dang lhan cig ces sogs la/ gsal rig chos can/
